##### Project general facts

340 Riverside Crescent is a spectacular tower nestled within Sobha Hartland II, encompassing a rich sense of community and superlative waterfront living in one of the city's most sought-after locations. This exquisite development offers elegant-styled abodes expertly crafted to create a sense of relaxed wellbeing amid lavish surrounds for everlasting luxury. With a collection of residences that mirror the soul, 340 Riverside Crescent is a depiction of true vibrancy, close to the pulsating heart of Dubai, offering a front-row seat to outstanding waterfront living.

Residents discover a sense of belonging among like-minded residents, where the bonds of genuine community living are fostered through high-quality amenities, creating a truly enriching experience. Take a plunge into a generously sized infinity pool and simply relax your stresses away. Reward mind and body with cutting-edge fitness trails that elevate endurance and stamina. Sky Gardens offer inspiring views across the city, while the boardwalk provides endless culinary delights. The development has been thoughtfully contemplated to create a welcoming and peaceful environment where recreation is the name of the game.

Every residence at 340 Riverside Crescent features elegant-styled abodes expertly crafted to create a sense of relaxed wellbeing amid lavish surrounds. The interiors are designed with timeless quality, offering fully equipped kitchens and thoughtfully conceived living spaces. From the inspiring surroundings to the pristine beaches and sprawling greenery visible from exclusive Sky Gardens, every detail is crafted to enhance the discerning quality of life.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Sobha Hartland II, this exceptional location offers more than eight million square feet of exquisite waterfront serenity, close to the pulsating heart of Dubai. The community provides a rich sense of community and superlative waterfront living in one of the city's most sought-after locations, with pristine beaches and sprawling greenery creating a tranquil environment.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity and vibrant community ambience. Residents enjoy inspiring surroundings with views of the vibrant Dubai skyline, while the boardwalk offers endless culinary delights. The community's thoughtful planning ensures a welcoming and peaceful environ, with inspiring views across the city coming as standard from the exclusive Sky Gardens haven.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland II delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can discover a mirror to their soul.
